proposal.reason: The substantive change is CI workflow behavior: dual-platform (M890P+810E) test generation/selection/grouping, runner allocation and rack policy, optional HPN SDK install handling, and result/log/report reconciliation across daily and source-sanity pipelines. Added/updated xtest scripts, workflow scripts, and the patch-omitted large test-list JSON files are all CI test-input/orchestration data rather than production runtime modules.
